definition: The European Association for Artificial Intelligence (EurAI), formerly the European Coordinating Committee for Artificial Intelligence (ECCAI), is a European organization representing national artificial intelligence societies and research communities.
details: Its aim is to promote the study, research, and application of artificial intelligence (AI) in Europe.
story: Picture a novelist who has read so much that, given a first line, they cannot help but write the next one. It makes new things by recombining everything it has ever seen. The result feels creative because it is memory, reshuffled at speed. It is prediction pushed forward — each next word, or pixel, guessed from everything that came before it. And that is European Association for Artificial Intelligence — making something new out of everything it has ever seen.
